# MoveFlow repository instructions

Read root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing and follow the relevant documents it links. Inspect existing files and Git changes first; complete one small task without unrelated edits. Reuse the installed stack and keep code student-readable.

The app is a fresh frontend starter. Product features and Supabase are planned; do not implement future stages without task authorization. Follow [AI workflow](../docs/AI_WORKFLOW.md) for security, dependencies, and commit discipline and [Development](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for verification. Report every changed file and actual check results.
